name: BeatXswap
rootCause: slot0 spot-price oracle with no TWAP guard drains vesting BTX reserves. Lost: ~$63.7K USDT net profit (2,984,557 BTX / ~$77.5K drained from two vesting reserves)

descriptions.text: slot0 spot-price oracle with no TWAP guard drains vesting BTX reserves. Lost: ~$63.7K USDT net profit (2,984,557 BTX / ~$77.5K drained from two vesting reserves)

BeatXswap’s LiquidityVestingConvert used the Uniswap/Pancake V3 slot0() spot price as its only oracle, with no TWAP or deviation checks. An attacker flash-loaned 6,000,000 BTX, dumped it to crash the pool price, then called deposit() twice (10,000 + 2,000 USDT) to mint LP at the manipulated quote and drain 2,984,557 BTX (~$77,512).

BeatXswap’s LV Convert contracts on BNB Chain were drained on 2026-09-09 after an attacker flash-borrowed BTX, pushed down the Pancake V3 spot price used as the only oracle, and minted LP against protocol-owned BTX. Public trackers put the loss at about 2.985 million BTX, roughly $77,512. The converter contracts trusted a single Pancake V3 slot0() spot read for BTX pricing and reused that same manipulated quote to size the mint and the slippage floor. A same-transaction BTX dump could move the pool price before deposit() ran, so the contracts minted LP against a crashed oracle price and spent protocol-owned BTX reserves.
